title: Acetate co-feeding increases Ethylene Glycol assimilation and Glycolic Acid production in Yarrowia lipolytica
publisher: Agrimi, Gennaro (University of Bari Aldo Moro); Messina, Eugenia (University of Bari Aldo Moro); Barile, Serena (University of Bari Aldo Moro); Lazar, Zbigniew (Wrocław University of Environmental and Life Sciences); Fosso, Bruno (University of Bari); Antonacci, Ylenia (National Research Council)
measurement_dates: Growth June 2023–December 2024; isotopes January–September 2025; flux/expression analyses July/September 2025.
author_preprocessing: Raw and processed cultivation/isotope tables, derived flux/expression products and publication figures. Metadata says CC BY 4.0; README says CC0; retain both and comply with attribution.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Group cultivations/conditions. Derived fluxes are model-dependent, not independent isotope measurements; source acetate benefit is a known finding.
